A growing town that still feels like a town

Wylie has grown fast, with new neighborhoods filling in along State Highway 78 and FM 544, but it hasn't lost its small-town side. There's the historic downtown, lake days close by (Wylie sits between Lavon Lake and Lake Ray Hubbard), and plenty of families who moved here for a little more house and a little more breathing room.

Growth means a lot of homes changing hands and a lot of brand-new builds getting their first real clean. We provide house cleaning in Wylie, TX for all of it, from the empty new home that still has construction dust in the cabinets to the lived-in family house that needs a steady hand every other week. Our team is based in Richardson, and Wylie is an easy drive east.

"Lindsey did a fantastic job on our first deep clean – you could truly see the difference everywhere, from the fans and the baseboards to the living room windows I specifically asked for." — K. McGee

Just closed on a new build?

New construction looks clean until you open a drawer. Fine dust settles inside cabinets, on window sills and along every baseboard. Book a post-construction cleaning once the builder is finished, or a move-in clean before the movers arrive, so you unpack into a home that's actually clean.

Every service we offer in Wylie

  • Standard cleaning: the essentials in every room.
  • Deep cleaning: detailed bathroom cleaning, baseboard cleaning, cabinet cleaning on fronts and handles (plus the inside of cabinets if they're empty), and appliance cleaning inside the oven and fridge.
  • Move-in / move-out cleaning: for buyers, sellers and renters.
  • Recurring cleaning: weekly, every other week or monthly.
  • Airbnb and short-term rental cleaning: guest-ready turnovers.
  • Post-construction cleaning: for new builds and remodels.
  • Pet-friendly house cleaning: built for homes with dogs and cats.

Also available: one-time cleaning for holidays and get-togethers.

Lake weekends, muddy paws, and real life

Days at the lake and dogs in the backyard mean sand by the door and hair on the rugs. We're pet-friendly, and we use eco-friendly, pet-safe products. Tell us about your pets in the booking form and we'll plan for them.

What we clean on every visit

  • Kitchen counters, sink, stovetop, appliance exteriors and microwave
  • Bathrooms: toilets, tubs, showers, glass, mirrors and fixtures
  • Dusting throughout, beds made and trash emptied
  • All floors vacuumed and mopped
  • Deep cleans add: spot-cleaned baseboards, ceiling fans, blinds, switch plates, window sills, cabinet fronts (plus the inside of cabinets if they're empty), soap scum and grout, and inside the oven and fridge; move-in/move-out cleans also add door frames, inside vanities and closet shelving
